lines.text: During the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra, a descendant of Aaron the chief priest, came up from Babylon.
Ezra left Babylon on the first day of the first month and reached Jerusalem on the first day of the ninth month.
Ezra set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach it in Israel.
King Artaxerxes allowed only priests and Levites to go with Ezra, and told him to buy animals for offerings with the silver and gold.

wrong_details.wrong: only priests and Levites may go with Ezra
wrong_details.true: any volunteers among the Israelites, including priests and Levites, may go

lines.text: Ezra blessed the LORD, the God of his fathers, took courage, and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with him.
